title: Experimental Apparatus (Bach et al. 2013)
html:
Remark. Experimental Apparatus (Bach et al. 2013)

The apparatus consists of an electron beam with energy 600 eV (\lambda_{\mathrm{dB}} = 50 pm) generated by a thermionic tungsten filament and electrostatic lenses. The beam is collimated by a slit of 2\;\mu\text{m} width and 10\;\mu\text{m} height placed at 16.5 cm. The double-slit is located 30.5 cm from the collimation slit.

The resulting patterns are magnified by an electrostatic quadrupole lens and imaged on a two-dimensional microchannel plate and phosphorus screen, then recorded with a charge-coupled device camera.

The collimation slit, double-slit, and mask were fabricated by focused ion beam (FIB) milling into 100 nm silicon-nitride membrane windows, coated with approximately 2 nm of gold.
